units: <cite ref="Ketubot 85a:1">Keth. 85ᵃ</cite> <he>מְמַלַּח מַלּוּחֵי</he> (not <he>מימלח</he>) rowed the boat (as an act of possession).

<cite ref="Bava Kamma 117b:10">B. Kam. 117ᵇ</cite> <he>מ׳ ביה חד מינייהו</he> (Alf.) one of them tried to keep the boat in balance (against the ass that threatened to upset it); [ed. <he>מַ׳ ליה לחמרא</he> (Var. <cite ref="M01461"><he>מלא</he></cite>, v. Rabb. D. S. a. l. note 90) he tried to counterbalance the ass].
